paragraphs.text: Keskit , The Flesh Sculptor , is a human / Phyrexian artificer from Mirrodin/New Phyrexia .

Keskit is a Phyrexian obsessed with his praetor , Sheoldred . He believes her to be the epitome of perfection and desires only to remake the world in her image. Keskit had the auspicious duty of compleating any new subjects that came under Sheoldred's rule, and often they ended up with spider -like features reminiscent of the praetor. Keskit seems to have survived Elesh Norn 's invasion of Sheoldred's domain and its subsequent migration to the Dross Pits, working to improve competitors in his mistress's arena.
